Floods in India: Rising Water Levels in Rivers

Rising water levels in rivers have caused floods in several parts of India, affecting communication and prompting administrative responses. The floods are a result of heavy rainfall in some areas. Authorities have issued alerts and taken measures to mitigate the impact.
